f-079-015-01.label: أواخر آي هذه السورة
f-079-015-01.note: Al-Nāziʿāt, from هل أتاك حديث موسى (verse 15). Ḥamza and Khalaf give a fatḥa to دحاها. Warsh gives a pure fatḥa to those that end in a hāʾ and an alif, except ذكراها (between the two, because of the rāʾ).
